evals.prompt: apps/dashboard의 기존 디자인 기준에 토큰 출처와 Decisions Log만 보완해줘. 기존 문서 형식과 규칙은 유지해줘.
evals.expected_output: Updates the nearest app design source additively and preserves its component rules.
expectations: Uses apps/dashboard/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md rather than root DESIGN.md.
Preserves existing token values, headings and component architecture rules.
Adds only relevant source mapping and decision evidence; no invented approval or browser pass.

evals.prompt: apps/reading에 조용한 종이와 잉크 컨셉의 DESIGN.md 초안을 작성해줘. 아직 색상이나 폰트는 확정하지 않았어.
evals.expected_output: Creates a target-local proposed brief with concrete, explicitly proposed tokens.
expectations: Separates the selected concept from proposed palette/type values.
Does not invent research, an existing design system, or user approval of token choices.
